newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins higher after long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins higher after long weekend.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds were quoted higher on Monday, compared with late Wednesday, the previous working day in Russia, but dealers said prices edged down from morning levels on local selling in the absence of London traders.
Markets were closed on May 1 and 2 for public holidays. Monday is a bank holiday in Britain.
"Selling is logical for people who left the market at lower levels (on Wednesday). Russian banks may not yet be ready psychologically to buy," Aljba Alliance Bank dealer Sergei Seryogin said.
But volumes traded were low the first day after Russia's holiday and on that of London traders, dealers said.
"Banks are cautious and are selling and do not expect further moves (on Tuesday)," one deealer said.
